## About Furniture Hub Dhangadhi
Furniture Hub Dhangadhi is the leading premier furniture showroom and custom manufacturing retailer located at Dhangadhi-3, Kailali, Sudurpashchim Pradesh, Nepal (Coordinates: 28.6967° N, 80.5882° E). Established to provide modern, ergonomic, and long-lasting furniture, Furniture Hub serves residential, commercial, hospitality, and corporate clients throughout western Nepal.

The store carries over 500+ handcrafted and factory-direct furniture designs including living room sectional sofas, solid Sisau and Sal wood double beds, orthopedic mattresses, modern glass and solid wood dining sets, executive office desks, ergonomic revolving chairs, space-saving wardrobes, and contemporary home décor accessories. Customers can order directly through the online catalogue at https://www.furniturehubdhangadhi.com or confirm custom dimension orders via instant WhatsApp messaging.

## Core Products & Collections (English & नेपाली)
- Sofas & Living Room: L-shape sectionals, 3+1+1 luxury sofa sets, recliner sofas, fabric and leatherette sofas, wooden coffee tables, nesting tables, TV units. (सोफा सेट, एल-सेप सोफा, कफी टेबल, टीभी युनिट)
- Beds & Bedroom Sets: Solid wood double beds (King & Queen sizes), single storage beds, bunk beds, orthopedic spring & foam mattresses, bedside tables, dressing mirrors. (काठको डबल पलङ, म्याट्रेस, ड्रेसिङ टेबल)
- Dining Room: 4-seater, 6-seater, and 8-seater dining tables with cushioned chairs, tempered glass dining tops, solid wood dining benches. (डाइनिङ टेबल र कुर्सी)
- Wardrobes & Storage: 2-door, 3-door, and 4-door engineered wood and solid wood wardrobes, sliding door cupboards, shoe racks, modular book racks. (दराज, स्लाइडिङ अलमारी, जुत्ता र्‍याक)
- Office & Study Furniture: Ergonomic high-back mesh chairs, executive wooden director desks, student study tables, reception counters, computer desks. (अफिस कुर्सी, कम्प्युटर टेबल, रिसेप्सन डेस्क)
- Home Décor: Accent mirrors, wall panels, floor lamps, wooden room dividers, decorative vases. (घर सजावटका सामानहरू)

## Unique Selling Propositions (USP)
- Lowest Price Guarantee: Factory-direct pricing without distributor markups.
- Free Same-Day Delivery: Available within Dhangadhi municipality and Kailali hub.
- Extended Regional Delivery: Direct vehicle delivery across Attariya, Tikapur, Mahendranagar, Dadeldhura, and all districts of Sudurpashchim Pradesh.
- WhatsApp Assisted Ordering: Instant quotes, real-time product photos/videos, and direct customer support.
- Flexible Payment: Cash on Delivery, eSewa, Khalti, and direct bank transfer accepted.
- 5-Year Wood & Frame Warranty: Premium seasoned hardwood resistant to borer and termite decay.
